next_external_step: Local technical acceptance is complete. Restore GitHub connectivity/write authentication to deliver queued commits; no Windows reinstall is required.
completion_rule: Do not mark complete until original-game behavior and declared supported scenario parity have been verified. Simulator-only tests do not prove local game parity.
limitations: Installed release v0.107.1 is bound to local reference and runtime hashes; file consistency is not a publisher signature.
Validation covers three starter encounters, ten development seeds and two fixed policies plus a separate boundary probe; it does not establish full-game parity or complete hidden-RNG equivalence.
Comparison excludes catalog-derived card values and fields unavailable after combat.
Same-host rebuilds reproduce public trajectories; binaries differ. No second-machine installation or isolated throughput claim.
Response loss was deliberately injected around a real game request; no natural network outage is claimed.
Search, hierarchical policies, RL training and original-game image capture are later-stage work.
